decisions.reason: The compact modular trommel screen is a direct evolution of the firm's existing screening equipment (BASIC 518 to 518 FLEX), so the firm's related knowledge supports learning and improvement, making it likely to remain.

Mobile high-speed flail shredders extend the firm's existing shredding and processing machinery knowledge, and the firm's own R&D and technical development allow it to absorb and apply feedback, so it is likely to be kept.

Mobile high-speed grinders fit the firm's core capabilities in waste processing and shredding, enabling the firm to interpret market results and refine the product, so it is likely to stay on the market.

Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are a new generation within an established shredder line (CERON), directly building on related knowledge, so the firm is likely to keep improving and selling them.
